guitar.notes: Jeff Beck is one of the most famous Stratocaster players, with his own long-running Fender Jeff Beck Signature Strat; extensively documented.

tone.target: bright crunchy 60s lead with vocal wah bite
tone.profile: bright crunchy 60s lead with vocal wah bite
tone.summary: A bright, crunchy 60s lead tone achieved using a Plexi-style amp model, boosted by an OD pedal for grit, incorporating a central Wah sweep, and finished with a dry room ambiance.

rig.name: Jeff Beck - Hi Ho Silver Lining - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and hum.
Provide the necessary 'bright crunch' and grit associated with 60s lead tones.
Implement the required 'vocal wah sweep' and centralize its role in the tone.
Optional secondary grit boost for extra bite without heavy fuzz (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: The Green OD is sufficient, but RAT-style can add aggressive mid-range punch if needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi edge and provide a bright, articulate 60s foundation.
Match the required 'Marshall/Plexi edge' and classic British sound profile.
Enhance 'forward mids' and compensate for the natural scoop of the amp/cab setup.
Provide the required 'dry room' ambiance without sounding lush or overly wet.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and vintage character.

proposals.reason: Enhance classic British tone and mid-range punch for 60s lead.
